# ADR-3005: A01: Mass-assignment field pack for form surface 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Mass assignment lets clients set role or price fields.

## Decision

Services SHALL NOT bind an unfiltered mass-assignment field pack for form surface 5 (A01-5).

## Consequences

Allow-lists define writable fields per role.
